issues.finding: 61 fixture numeric values exceed JS safe integer; authorId and workflow userId occur. Convert identifiers to strings before serializing from backend. Rounded captured numbers cannot be repaired by String() after JSON.parse.
Explicit template detail mock uses row.id; real list row key is templateId. It returns null for valid selection.
Explicit recommended/list mock returns Page and shadows real array fixture. Legacy contract expects array and request is recommendedSize, no compositionId.
Fixture lookup keys only path + optional type/productType; getDictConfig dictTypes, workflow id, category/tag filters are ignored.
Fixture replay overwrites total=returned rows, pages=1,hasNext=false; b.page>1 becomes empty; ignores requested size,current,cursor. Cannot be backend pagination specification.
Community composition/detail fixture is FLAT; {detail,canvasContent} belongs to admin helper transform only. Do not use nested detail shape for public endpoint.
Homepage cg resolves objectURL. This is tab-local preview URL and unsuitable as persisted upload/generation input. Other legacy ri paths are separate.

Homepage canvas/create {} just opens editor and carries launch payload in browser storage/query. Own /v1/generations needs explicit adapter; implementing only that new route will not make legacy original bundle generate.
Unknown paths return code0 {} and mutation-like controls falsely report success. Quote {} can imply zero or retry; unsupported capabilities need explicit error.
__replicaRequests logs method:local rather than actual XHR/fetch HTTP method. It cannot prove endpoint methods; use static caller evidence.
Unsigned synthetic token bypasses only UI gates. Revoke preview seeding when switching to backend; real JWT/HttpOnly session must be validated server-side.
QA observed Creative Member package area empty despite product fixture. Need product config compatibility and packageList/defaultPackageId/rightConfigList validation.

importantBoundaries: Routes merely present in imported original bundle are not reserved backend implementations.
Only fixture response capture proves original returned shape; static caller evidence does not prove permissions or successful request.
Avoid raw original provider API URLs/credentials; proxy own validated backend provider integration.
